services.name: Why Horses?
services.desc: Those who are familiar with horses understand the power of horses to influence people in incredible ways. Developing relationships, training, horsemanship, and caring for the horses naturally affects the people involved in a meaningful way. Work ethic, responsibility, assertiveness, communication and healthy relationships have long been recognized and horses naturally provide these benefits. Horses are amazing creatures and do not care what age or gender you are. They love being around people and are wanting to work with you.
